description: This file is a shell script library ('lib') used in Git merge tools, defining functions for handling different merge tool operations within Git. It provides utility functions for sourcing in other scripts to manage merge operations.

methods.name: get_merge_tool
methods.description: Returns the merge tool to use, indicating if it was guessed via the return code; also respects the GIT_MERGETOOL_GUI environment variable for GUI search.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_cmd
methods.description: Provides the custom command for executing a specified merge tool.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path for the selected merge tool.

methods.name: initialize_merge_tool
methods.description: Sets up merge tool specific functions into the environment for use or overriding.

methods.name: run_merge_tool
methods.description: Launches a merge tool given its name and whether a merge base is present, requiring specific environment variables to be set.
